transcript: Speaker A: Hindi medium mein padhte hain, mujhe bilkul English bolna nahi aata. Bas teen steps follow karke I have started speaking like any English medium student. Sabse pehle toh aap apne phone mein PW Talk app download kar lo. Number one, basics clear karo. Uske liye PW Talk app par reels jaise chhote-chhote videos hain jinhein Physics Wallah ki team ne banaya hai. Jab bhi free time mile toh reels ki jagah inhein dekho. Bina kisi mehnat ke aapke basics clear ho jayenge. Number do, practice karo dimag se. Nouns, pronouns ya dictionary ka ratta maarne se kabhi bhi English speaking achhi nahi hone wali. PW Talk app par aapko aisi exercises milengi jo aapko real life mein use hone wali English sikhayengi. Din mein 10 se 15 minute hi practice karna kaafi hai. Number teen, bolna shuru karo bina dare, zyada se zyada English mein baat karna start karo. Lekin doston ke samne bolne se galti karne ka darr rehta hai, isiliye PW Talk app ke AI teacher ki help le sakte ho jo aapki galtiyon ko judge nahi karegi aur aapko sahi English sikhayegi. Toh basics, exercises aur real speaking ki practice, teeno ek hi app par kar sakte ho. Abhi PW Talk app download kar lo. [I studied in Hindi medium and didn't know how to speak English at all. By following just three steps, I have started speaking like an English medium student. First, download the PW Talk app on your phone. Number one, clear your basics. For that, there are short reel-like videos on the PW Talk app made by the Physics Wallah team. Whenever you get free time, watch these instead of reels. Your basics will be cleared without any effort. Number two, practice smartly. Rote learning nouns, pronouns, or the dictionary will never improve your English speaking. On the PW Talk app, you will find exercises that teach you English used in real life. Practicing for just 10 to 15 minutes a day is enough. Number three, start speaking without fear, start talking in English as much as possible. But there is always a fear of making mistakes in front of friends, so you can take help from the PW Talk app's AI teacher who won't judge your mistakes and will teach you correct English. So you can practice basics, exercises, and real speaking all on one app. Download the PW Talk app now.]
